Switzerland has no single head of state or government. The seven-member Federal Council acts collectively; the president chairs it for one calendar year and cannot be re-elected for the following year. Only the 2026 president (Parmelin) is listed. The other members need entries or a site-level decision: Ignazio Cassis (Vice-President 2026, born 1961-04-13), Karin Keller-Sutter (born 1963-12-22), Albert Rösti (born 1967-08-07), Élisabeth Baume-Schneider, Beat Jans and Martin Pfister (birth dates not retrieved). Those birth dates come from Wikipedia and need official confirmation.

Parmelin: in_office_since and term_ends refer to the 2026 presidency (one-year term, from the federal government site and swissinfo). He has been a Federal Councillor since 2016-01-01 (Wikipedia). term_ends 2026-12-31 is derived from the one-year calendar term. Federal Council terms are four years, set after each federal parliamentary election.
